To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the best MDC performance can be achieved when intra coding is done selectively in MDC streams.

(i) the intra coding criterion is a good choice for MDC streams; (ii) the redundancy optimization is not a must; and (iii) the proposed method outperforms the other optimized methods in the literature.
the best policy for intra coding in MDC is to encode selective I-frames instead of intra coding some macroblocks in a frame.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new intra coding criterion for MDC video streams.
the design, implementation and performance evaluation of an MDC scheme with selective I-frames for video streaming over lossy packet networks.
the design of a new intra coding technique in multiple description coding.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed intra coding method in MDC provides better performance in terms of both PSNR and complexity.
the proposed method outperforms other MDC schemes in the literature, in terms of average PSNR, with the least increase in complexity.
the proposed scheme outperforms the other MDC schemes for both the intra and inter frame types.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an efficient method to decide the intra frame positions in MDC video transmission, which is based on an optimization of the PSNR performance.
the proposed intra coding scheme is a promising technique that could be used to improve the MDC performance.
the proposed MDC scheme with intra frame selection is able to achieve higher PSNR than the other optimized MCDs found in the literatures.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed intra coding approach can improve the MDC performance in the absence of any redundancy optimization.
, in MCD, it is not always the best policy to use intra coding for the whole frame.
, in MCD, it is better to encode some I-frames than to encode some macroblocks of the frames in intra mode.
